symbol.description: Any Yahoo-recognised symbol: bare ticker (`AAPL`), index (`^DJI`), crypto (`BTC-USD`), FX (`EURUSD=X`).

interval.description: Candle resolution. Default `1d`. Note Yahoo only serves intraday (sub-day) intervals for ~30 days back; daily-and-up go back decades.

range.description: How far back to fetch. Default `1mo`. Must be compatible with the chosen `interval` — for example `1m` with `range=1y` returns no data.
